Roofs & drainage / GOLD COAST

Preparing commercial roofs and gutters for storm season

A practical scope for roof defects, outlets and the path rainwater takes.

Ellis Services Group · Maintenance notes

The City of Gold Coast notes that severe weather can occur throughout the year, with storms most common in spring and summer. We therefore plan roof and drainage maintenance around the building's condition and operating needs, rather than treating it as a single annual job.

We check reported leaks, visible roof defects, flashings, box gutters and accessible outlets. We also consider where the water goes next: an outlet problem and a downstream drainage problem can require different work. We distinguish clearing accumulated debris from repairing damaged components.

We agree roof access, protection for occupied areas and any weather-dependent stages before attendance. The handover records the areas inspected and repaired, with photos and any remaining investigation. A previous leak location becomes part of the next inspection record.
